english.title: Contravene / fail to comply with a regulation 6(2) requirement to plant a new hedge
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having removed a hedgerow to which the Hedgerows Regulations 1997 applied, the removal only being permitted by regulation 6(1)(a) of those regulations, failed to fill the existing opening by planting a hedge within 8 months of the making of the new opening
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(2) and (5) of the Hedgerows Regulations 1997.
